# Singularity University · KdK Krzb.

> An independent digital institution at the intersection of law, technology, infrastructure and intelligence — defining the academic frontier of Juridical Singularity and Electric Technocracy in the post-national era.

Singularity University KdK Krzb. is a developing educational and research platform focused on Juridical Singularity, Electric Technocracy, the Age of Transition, treaty-chain governance, AI-era international law, Direct Digital Democracy and 100% free global education.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Institutional overview and doctrine summary.
- [Juridical Singularity](/juridical-singularity.html): Doctrine on the unification of international legal systems through treaty chains and AI-era law.
- [Electric Technocracy](/electric-technocracy.html): Governance framework based on automation, Direct Digital Democracy, UBI and ASI coordination.
- [Research](/research.html): Key publications, papers and open research outputs.
- [Courses](/courses.html): Free online courses on New International Law, Treaty Chains, AI Governance and digital sovereignty.
- [News](/news.html): Editorial, research dispatches and syndicated technology wire.

## Optional

- [RSS Feed](/rss.xml): Full-text feed of the Public News Portal.
